# möbius for macOS 0.2.5

- One way to hear from möbius: progress, confirmations and problems arrive as
  notifications in the bottom-right corner instead of banners that push the page down.
- Signing in and connecting to möbius Cloud keep you where you are, instead of jumping
  from Settings to the gateway and then to your chats. A connected Cloud gateway no
  longer offers to connect again.
- The gateway you're connected to opens onto its overview, devices and host
  credentials, like a Bot opens onto its settings. A new Devices page lists every device
  paired with that gateway, and you can unpair any of them from there.
- Bots and gateways open and close smoothly in the sidebar, and their arrows turn with
  them.
- What's new: when no update is waiting, the button above the notification bell opens
  these release notes in the app. They're also in Settings.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later. Works with the same gateway (0.15.53,
protocol 86) as 0.2.0 through 0.2.4.
